from fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("message-template-server")

@mcp.tool()
def summarize(text: str) -> dict:
    """Generate a message template for summarizing text.
    
    Args:
        text: The text content to be summarized
    
    Returns:
        A user message template requesting summarization of the text
    """
    return {
        "role": "user",
        "content": f"Please summarize the following text:\n\n{text}"
    }

if __name__ == "__main__":
    mcp.run()
